title.zh: OpenSSH 10.6p2 针对未启用 PAM 的 Alpine 的关键变通方案
title.en: OpenSSH 10.6p2 Critical workaround for alpine without PAM

current_state.zh: Alpine Linux 已发布 OpenSSH-server 密码认证绕过漏洞的安全公告，解释了 musl crypt() 错误返回值导致无密码账户被长密码绕过的技术细节；OpenSSH 10.6p2 的变通方案已发布。
current_state.en: Alpine Linux has published a security advisory for the OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass, explaining the technical details of musl crypt() error return allowing long-password bypass of passwordless accounts; the OpenSSH 10.6p2 workaround has been released.

updates.title_zh: OpenSSH 10.6p2 针对未启用 PAM 的 Alpine 的关键变通方案

updates.what_changed_zh: OpenSSH 发布 10.6p2 版本说明，针对未启用 PAM 构建的 Alpine 系统提供关键变通方案，维护者解释称他们正放弃长期漏洞保密期，因为 AI 代理现在能在数小时内重新发现漏洞。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenSSH published 10.6p2 release notes with a critical workaround for Alpine systems built without PAM, and the maintainers explained they are moving away from long vulnerability embargoes because AI agents are now rediscovering bugs within hours.

updates.title_zh: Alpine Linux 安全公告：OpenSSH-server 密码认证绕过
updates.title_en: Alpine Linux Security advisory: OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass
updates.what_changed_zh: Alpine Linux 发布安全公告，详细说明 OpenSSH-server 密码认证绕过漏洞：musl 的 crypt() 在密钥超过 256 字节时返回错误指示符 '*'，该字符与无密码账户的存储哈希字段匹配，导致长密码登录成功。
updates.what_changed_en: Alpine Linux published a security advisory detailing the OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass: musl's crypt() returns the error indicator '*' when the key exceeds 256 bytes, which matches the stored hash field of accounts without a password, allowing long-password logins to succeed.
updates.current_state_zh: Alpine Linux 已发布 OpenSSH-server 密码认证绕过漏洞的安全公告，解释了 musl crypt() 错误返回值导致无密码账户被长密码绕过的技术细节；OpenSSH 10.6p2 的变通方案已发布。
updates.current_state_en: Alpine Linux has published a security advisory for the OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass, explaining the technical details of musl crypt() error return allowing long-password bypass of passwordless accounts; the OpenSSH 10.6p2 workaround has been released.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Alpine Linux published a security advisory for an OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass in which musl's crypt() error return value "*" matches the stored hash field of accounts without a password, allowing long-password logins to succeed.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Alpine Linux published a security advisory for an OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass in which musl's crypt() error return value "*" matches the stored hash field of accounts without a password, allowing long-password logins to succeed.
